statement: Blackwell GPUs could account for more than 70% of Nvidia's high-end market share by 2026, per estimates cited in this trade report.
why: The pace at which Blackwell displaces prior generations inside Nvidia's own mix sets the mix of pricing, margin and packaging demand across the merchant-GPU category.

impact.mechanism: A Blackwell-dominated high-end mix pulls demand toward higher-content packages with more HBM stacks and advanced packaging per unit.

evidence.excerpt: Blackwell GPUs could account for more than 70% of Nvidia's high-end market share by 2026
Cumulative shipments of Blackwell GPU packages are estimated to be in the low millions by late 2025

reasoning: The document states this as a forward-looking estimate ('could account for'), not a realised share measurement, so it is recorded as a hypothesis with no measured value.

confidence.basis: Forward estimate carried by a single secondary outlet with no named methodology or primary source.
